external_entities.name: insurance partner
external_entities.description: One of three insurance partners that supplies a daily extract.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Three insurance partners drop a daily extract for us.

external_entities.name: analysts
external_entities.description: Users who query the warehouse directly.

processes.name: Airflow scheduler
processes.description: A scheduler that runs at 02:00, lists the landing bucket, reads files, and triggers a Spark transform job for each file.
processes.source_excerpt: An Airflow scheduler running in the landing network wakes up at 02:00, lists the bucket, and reads whatever is there.
processes.notes: It does not check that a file came from the partner whose folder it landed in.

processes.name: Spark transform job
processes.description: A transform job that normalizes records and loads them into BigQuery.
processes.source_excerpt: The transform normalizes the records and loads them into BigQuery.
processes.notes: Nothing validates the row contents beyond the schema.

data_stores.name: landing bucket
data_stores.description: A bucket where insurance partners place daily claim-record extracts.
data_stores.source_excerpt: They push files into a landing bucket over SFTP.
data_stores.notes: The description does not state how the landing bucket is encrypted: "I don't know how the landing bucket is encrypted".

data_stores.name: Airflow metadata database
data_stores.description: Airflow's metadata database, which stores connection strings and partner keys.
data_stores.source_excerpt: Airflow keeps its connection strings and the partner keys in its own metadata database.
data_stores.notes: The description does not state whether the Airflow metadata database is encrypted at rest: "whether the Airflow metadata database is encrypted at rest". Both are on defaults as far as I know.

data_stores.name: BigQuery
data_stores.description: The warehouse containing normalized claim records with member names and dates of birth.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The transform normalizes the records and loads them into BigQuery.
data_stores.notes: Analysts have a dataset-wide grant and member-identifying columns have not been split out.

data_flows.name: push files
data_flows.description: An insurance partner pushes a daily extract into the landing bucket.
data_flows.source_excerpt: They push files into a landing bucket over SFTP.
data_flows.data_description: Claim records with member names and dates of birth.

data_flows.name: read files
data_flows.description: The Airflow scheduler lists the landing bucket and reads the files present there.
data_flows.source_excerpt: lists the bucket, and reads whatever is there
data_flows.notes: The scheduler does not check that a file came from the partner whose folder it landed in.
data_flows.data_description: Daily extract files containing claim records with member names and dates of birth.

data_flows.name: store credentials
data_flows.description: Airflow keeps connection strings and partner keys in its metadata database.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Airflow keeps its connection strings and the partner keys in its own metadata database.

data_flows.name: trigger transform
data_flows.description: For each file, the Airflow scheduler triggers a Spark transform job.
data_flows.source_excerpt: For each file the scheduler triggers a Spark transform job in the warehouse network.

data_flows.name: load records
data_flows.description: The Spark transform job loads normalized records into BigQuery.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The transform normalizes the records and loads them into BigQuery.
data_flows.data_description: Normalized claim records with member names and dates of birth.

data_flows.name: query warehouse
data_flows.notes: The analysts authenticate with SSO and have a dataset-wide grant.

trust_boundaries.name: insurance partner
trust_boundaries.description: The zone controlled by the insurance partner supplying the extract.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: Three insurance partners drop a daily extract for us.

trust_boundaries.name: landing network
trust_boundaries.description: The network where the Airflow scheduler and landing stores operate.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: An Airflow scheduler running in the landing network

trust_boundaries.name: warehouse network
trust_boundaries.description: The network where the Spark transform job and warehouse operate, and where analysts are located.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: They are on the warehouse network

assumptions.assumption: The insurance partner controls a separate trust zone from the system receiving its extracts.
assumptions.basis: The source identifies the actor as an insurance partner external to the receiving system; the boundary is therefore classified as tenant.

assumptions.assumption: The Airflow scheduler presents a non-web interface.
assumptions.basis: It is described as a scheduled Airflow batch scheduler that lists a bucket and triggers jobs, not as a web application.

assumptions.assumption: The Spark transform job presents a non-web interface.
assumptions.basis: It is described as a Spark transform job that processes files and loads records, not as a web application.

assumptions.assumption: The landing bucket contains confidential data.
assumptions.basis: The extracts contain claim records with member names and dates of birth, which are personal and health-related data.

assumptions.assumption: The Airflow metadata database contains confidential data.
assumptions.basis: It stores connection strings and partner keys, which are credentials and secrets.
The transform loads normalized claim records containing member names and dates of birth into BigQuery.
